object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G10, CF-G11, Q-G3; review Q9. A failed action puts the files back (MELLON-STORE-SRS-174) but not the window's copy, so the next edit could write from a copy that matches nothing on disk. Its own message, not the Changed on disk banner, since the files may not have changed. Shall: with the dialog rate-limited (MELLON-GUI-SRS-24), this is what tells the user an edit didn't land.
object.description: After an unexpected error during an action of a Document Editor, the Document Editor shall refuse each edit, with a message that names the error and says to reload, until the user reloads.
